title: agg run report, schema_version 1
description: agg/private/report.json, written atomically when `agg run` (or a Rust driver) ends for any reason. `outcome` is authoritative. A missing report means the process was killed (SIGKILL, OOM, power loss): treat it as outcome `error`. Any change to this shape bumps schema_version and ships a new file.

agg_version.description: the agg version that wrote the report

run_id.description: fresh per run; also stamped into agg/private/run.log

project.description: the config's `project:` name; empty if the config could not be read

outcome.description: done: done_if held. aborted: abort_if fired or a session cap was reached. stopped: agg stop / SIGTERM / SIGINT. error: a fault in agg or its environment. Precedence when several hold at one session end: error > stopped > done > aborted.

exit_code.description: 0 done, 3 abort_if, 4 session cap, 5 stopped, 1 error

stop_reason.description: human-readable: the abort_if expression that fired, the cap, the stop reason, or `error: <message>`

error.description: the error chain or panic message when outcome is error

merged.description: sessions whose work a gate merged onto the base branch

rolled_back.description: sessions whose work a gate discarded

staged_unmerged.description: sessions staged on a span no gate decided (see result.staged_branch)

judges.description: every judge the run consulted, keyed by name

final_commit.description: the tip of base_branch after the last gate

staged_branch.description: tip of a span no gate decided; `git merge` it to land that work

ledger.description: the verdict ledger; its row format is internal

evidence_dir.description: this run's kept judge evidence, agg/private/evidence/<run_id>; null when none was kept

baseline.description: null on the driver path (no baseline pass)

value.description: null when the judge emitted no number

error.description: set when the judge could not grade at all

evidence.description: absolute paths of the evidence files agg kept for this verdict, under paths.evidence_dir; omitted when none were kept
